result.summary: Confirmed status vocabulary against docs/agents/protocols/ISSUE_QUEUE.md before writing anything: `resolved` requires a root cause actually removed plus a regression test proving it. That bar is met here -- ISSUE-FIXER's own Step 1 diagnosis (handoffs/WF03-ISS0881-20260929/step-01-issue-fixer-diagnose.json) identified the root cause as sandbox_pool_test.exs's `sandbox_schema_names/0` (lines 571-582) doing an unscoped, platform-wide read of every sandbox_% schema, with no filter tying it to the test's own pool instance -- so unrelated concurrent partitions (scripts/test_parallel.sh) creating/dropping their own sandbox schemas during a test's baseline-to-final window could flip a platform-wide equality assertion even though the test's own pool behaved correctly. CODE-DESIGNER's design (lib/letflow/design/iss0881-sandbox-pool-test-isolation.md, PASSed by CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR) and ELIXIR-DEV's implementation (step-03 handoff, PASS: mix compile --warnings-as-errors clean, mix test test/letflow/sandbox_pool_test.exs 23 passed) replaced every platform-wide equality check at RT-1..RT-8 and the ISS-0292/RT-8 diff-order test with scoped membership/diff checks tied to each test's own minted schema name(s) -- no production code (lib/letflow/sandbox_pool.ex) touched, and SECURITY-REVIEWER/REVIEWER both PASSed. TEST-DESIGNER's regression test (test/letflow/sandbox_pool_test.exs:1374) injects a real extraneous sandbox_% schema during the baseline-to-final window; TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR independently re-applied the mutant itself (not copied from the report) and reproduced both halves with its own quoted output: mutated (old platform-wide `assert final == baseline`) -> fails with `left: MapSet.new(["sandbox_noise_test_2"]), right: MapSet.new([])`; reverted -> `1 passed`, `git status --porcelain lib/ test/` empty, full file re-run 24 passed. This satisfies `resolved`'s bar (root cause removed + independently-reproduced fail-then-pass regression proof) -- not `instrumented` (a real fix was shipped, not just diagnostic capability) and not `no_defect` (a real, confirmed root cause existed and was removed). Wrote docs/issues/ISS-0881.yaml: status: resolved, resolved_in_run: WF03-ISS0881-20260929, resolved_at: 2026-09-29T07:50:00Z, and a resolution: field citing the exact file paths/line numbers from the Step 1/2/3/4b handoffs. Verified gh authentication (`gh auth status` -> logged in as tvolodi) and that GitHub issue 1958 was open (`gh issue view 1958` -> state OPEN) before closing. Closed it: `gh issue close 1958 --comment "Fixed in WF03-ISS0881-20260929. See docs/issues/ISS-0881.yaml and the regression test at test/letflow/sandbox_pool_test.exs (describe block at line 1374, ...). Fail-then-pass proof independently reproduced by TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR."` -> real output: `Closed issue tvolodi/letflow#1958 (ISS-0880: SandboxPoolTest ISS-0224-regression RT-6 (death path c) fails intermittently under full parallel suite)`.
